{"id":1993830315,"question_id":4291,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1777780124,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"20 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1993830315/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Cost to Move Between Indices","memory":"226.1 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<int> minCost(vector<int>& nums, vector<vector<int>>& queries) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        vector<int>ans;\n        vector<int>leftcost(n , 0);\n        vector<int>rightcost(n , 0);\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n-1 ; i++){\n            int cost = 0;\n            if(i == 0) cost = 1;\n            else {\n                int leftdist = nums[i] - nums[i-1];\n                int rightdist = nums[i+1] - nums[i];\n\n                if(rightdist < leftdist) cost = 1;\n                else cost = rightdist;\n            }\n            rightcost[i+1] = rightcost[i] + cost;\n        }\n        \n        for(int i = n-1 ; i>0; i--){\n            int cost = 0;\n            if(i == n-1) cost = 1;\n            else {\n                int leftdist = nums[i] - nums[i-1];\n                int rightdist = nums[i+1] - nums[i];\n\n                if(leftdist <= rightdist) cost = 1;\n                else cost = leftdist;\n            }\n            leftcost[i-1] = leftcost[i] + cost;\n        }\n\n        for(auto &it : queries){\n            int st = it[0];\n            int end = it[1];\n\n            if(st < end){\n                ans.push_back(rightcost[end] - rightcost[st]);\n            }\n            else if(st > end){\n                ans.push_back(leftcost[end] - leftcost[st]);\n            }\n            else ans.push_back(0);\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-cost-to-move-between-indices","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1968}
